metadata.scenario: An individual inquiring about store hours and holiday closures contacts the business. Category: General Information. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Patricia Wilson. I was referred by Dr. Anderson, and I need information about services for my mother. Of course, Patricia. What specific services are you interested in? She’s going to need post-surgery care after her hip replacement coming up next week. We can definitely help with that. Our post-surgery recovery care starts at $85 and goes up to $110. That sounds good. But I also wanted to know your hours and if you have any holiday closures. Sure! We’re open Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 7 PM, Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and we’re on-call for emergencies on Sundays. Great! Are you closed for any holidays coming up? We are closed on major holidays, but you can always reach our emergency team on Sundays. That’s good to know. Can I schedule an appointment for my mother’s post-surgery care? Absolutely! I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, who can help set up the schedule. Perfect, can you give me her contact information? Yes, her direct number is +13165559203, and she’s available Monday through Saturday. Thanks, I’ll reach out to her. Is there anything else I should know? Just to remind you, we can also assist with medication management and personal care if needed. That would be helpful. I’ll mention that to Lisa when I call. Great! If you have any further questions, don’t hesitate to call us back. I appreciate your help today! You’re very welcome, Patricia. Have a great day, and we look forward to helping your mother! Thank you! Goodbye. Goodbye!
